# homarr_app (Data Source)

Looks up a single Homarr app by `id` or by `name`. Exactly one of the two must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing app by name...
data "homarr_app" "grafana" {
  name = "Grafana"
}

# ...or by id.
data "homarr_app" "by_id" {
  id = "k723ruvksaauzjvapxpmt9f6"
}

output "grafana_href" {
  value = data.homarr_app.grafana.href
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the app to look up.
- `name` (String) Name of the app to look up. Homarr does not enforce unique app names; if several apps share a name the lookup fails rather than picking one arbitrarily.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the app.
- `href` (String) URL the app tile links to.
- `icon_url` (String) Icon URL of the app.
- `ping_url` (String) URL Homarr pings for the app's online status.
